entries.title: FinCEN proposes strengthened customer due diligence requirements for covered financial institutions, comments due January 19, 2027
entries.facts: FinCEN published a notice of proposed rulemaking, Customer Due Diligence Requirements for Covered Financial Institutions, in the Federal Register on November 19, 2026 as document 2026-23614, RIN 1506-AB78, docket FINCEN-2026-0298. The proposal amends 31 CFR part 1010, and specifically 31 CFR 1010.230. The ACTION line reads Proposed rule and the DATES paragraph reads in full: Comments must be received by January 19, 2027. The summary states that FinCEN proposes to strengthen customer due diligence requirements under the Customer Due Diligence Rule as directed by Executive Order 14406, that covered financial institutions would collect sufficient information to verify the identities of beneficial owners of legal entity customers, and that institutions would retain authority to obtain further information where warranted. The Federal Register page citation is not stated here because it was not confirmed. The rule text was read in part only, and the portion read contains no reference to virtual currency or digital assets.
entries.source_label: Federal Register, FinCEN notice of proposed rulemaking, document 2026-23614 (govinfo PDF)
entries.relevant_to: banks, broker-dealers, futures commission merchants, payments and fintech firms with covered-institution obligations

entries.title: NYSE American becomes a fourth exchange with an immediately effective filing permitting binary options on key performance indicators
entries.facts: The SEC published Federal Register document 2026-23425 on November 18, 2026, titled Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend Its Rules To Permit the Listing of Binary Options Overlying Key Performance Indicators. The record carries Release No. 34-106898 and File No. SR-NYSEAMER-2026-97, with citation 91 FR 74244 and a regulations.gov docket, SEC-2026-7136-0001, showing zero comments as of November 19, 2026. The record states no comment close date and no separate effective date. Three other national securities exchanges carry filings on the same subject: NYSE Arca at 91 FR 74225, Miami International Securities Exchange at 91 FR 75361 and MEMX at 91 FR 75386. The filing's own text was not retrieved, so nothing about contract terms, settlement or position limits is stated here.
entries.source_label: Federal Register, SEC notice of filing and immediate effectiveness, document 2026-23425
entries.relevant_to: national securities exchanges, prediction-market platforms, derivatives venues, broker-dealers
